history.body: Hi, I came across Pearl Residences while browsing around Seberang Jaya. What’s the general price range there? I’m just trying to get a feel for the area and options.

The pricing reference I have shows base prices around RM328k–RM358k. That’s a guide, not a confirmed current total: the exact figure can vary by unit category and car-park configuration, and the latest package needs checking. I’ll confirm the current indicative range so you can compare options on a reliable basis. If you have a rough budget in mind, I can narrow the comparison too.
I’m only starting to compare, but I’m trying to keep around RM350,000 if I do buy. Would any options be near that once the car park and current package are included?

Possibly, but I can’t confirm an option at around RM350,000 all-in yet. The earlier RM328k–RM358k figures are base-price guidance; adding the lowest listed car-park premium of RM15k gives about RM343k before any package. That’s only an arithmetic guide, though—the figures may not match the same unit and car-park configuration, and the current package isn’t confirmed. So I wouldn’t treat it as a confirmed under-RM350k option.
